title: Adventurous
summary: ADVENT'UROUS, adjective 1. Inclined or willing to incur hazard; bold to encounter danger; daring; courageous; enterprizing; applied to persons. 2. Full of hazard; attended with risk; exposing to dange

inlines.v: ADVENT'UROUS, adjective 1. Inclined or willing to incur hazard; bold to encounter danger; daring; courageous; enterprizing; applied to persons. 2. Full of hazard; attended with risk; exposing to danger; requiring courage' applied to things; as, an adventurous undertaking. And followed freedom on the adventurous tide.
